question: Did the girl remove the cream knit top after putting on the blue sweater?
pred:
The video shows a woman displaying and then putting on several items of clothing. At the beginning, she holds up a light blue sweater and a cream-colored knit top. She first puts on the cream knit top (seen at 00:12). Subsequently, she puts on the light blue sweater over the cream top (starting around 00:15). Throughout the remainder of the video, including while she puts on a white ruffled skirt, the collar and bottom of the cream knit top remain visible underneath the blue sweater. There is no point in the video where she removes the cream top after putting on the sweater.

Evidence: Frames from 00:15 to the end of the video show the cream knit top's collar and ribbed hem visible underneath the light blue sweater.
Answer: No
